# Settings

<!-- Written by scripts/build-reference.mjs from the manifests' configuration. Do not edit: run npm run build. -->

The settings tools declare in their manifests, with the tool that owns each. Settings the workbench and its services register at run time (for the AI, the canvas, Python) are in the settings editor under their own groups and are not listed here.

| Key | Type | Default | Owner | Group | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `browser.blockAnnoyances` | boolean | true | browser | Browser | Also hide cookie consent banners, newsletter and social overlays and other annoyances (EasyList Cookie and the uBlock annoyance lists). Off: ads and trackers only, which is what Brave ships by default. |
| `browser.clearOnExit` | boolean | false | browser | Browser | Clear the browser's cookies, cache and site storage when Parallx closes. History and bookmarks stay. |
| `browser.holdRedirects` | boolean | true | browser | Browser | When a page you have been on sends you to another site on its own, wait for you to say Continue. Links you click and pages that redirect as soon as they load are not affected. A window a page opens on your click can never also send this tab elsewhere; that is blocked either way. |
| `browser.homepage` | string | "about:newtab" | browser | Browser | What a new tab shows. about:newtab is the built-in page with your bookmarks and recent history; any https address works too. |
| `browser.openLinksInApp` | boolean | true | browser | Browser | Open web links clicked anywhere in Parallx (pages, notes, chat, PDFs) in a browser tab here. Off: links open in your system browser. Open In System Browser in the page menu always does. |
| `browser.pageTheme` | system \\| dark \\| light | "system" | browser | Browser | What web pages are told you prefer. Sites that offer a dark theme follow it; sites without one are not changed. System uses your Windows setting. |
| `browser.searchEngine` | duckduckgo \\| brave \\| startpage \\| google | "duckduckgo" | browser | Browser | Where typed searches go. DuckDuckGo by default. |
| `browser.showBookmarksBar` | boolean | true | browser | Browser | Show your starred pages as a row of chips under the address bar. |
| `budget.gmailMcpServerId` | string | "gmail" | budget | Budget | The MCP server ID under which the Gmail server is registered (Settings → MCP Servers → row id). Defaults to 'gmail' to match the bundled catalog entry. If you renamed the row on install, update this to match exactly. |
| `budget.gmailQuery` | string | "from:chase.com" | budget | Budget | Gmail search filter applied to every sync. Defaults to Chase email only. Use Gmail search syntax if you need to add other issuers later. |
| `budget.syncMaxEmails` | number | 100 | budget | Budget | Gmail page size for each sync batch. Gmail's API ceiling is 500. The default of 100 fetches emails in batches of 100; the sync follows Gmail nextPageToken until all matching pages are exhausted, with an internal safety cap. |
| `budget.syncStartDate` | string | "" | budget | Budget | Absolute start date for the very first sync (no cursor yet), as YYYY-MM-DD. When set to a valid date, it pins the exact 'import everything from here' point and takes precedence over budget.syncStartDays. Leave blank to use the relative day window. |
| `budget.syncStartDays` | number | 90 | budget | Budget | On the very first sync (no cursor yet), import mail received within this many days. Ignored if budget.syncStartDate is set. |
| `chat.defaultMode` | ask \\| edit \\| agent | "agent" | chat | Chat | Chat mode a new session starts in. |
| `chat.fontFamily` | string | "" | chat | Chat | Chat message font family (empty = app font). |
| `chat.fontSize` | number | 13 | chat | Chat | Chat message font size in pixels. |
| `chat.nameWithModel` | boolean | true | chat | Chat | After its first answer, the chat's model names the chat in a few words. Off: a chat is named by its first words. |
| `chat.ollama.baseUrl` | string | "http://localhost:11434" | chat | Chat | Ollama server URL. |
| `dashboard.aiRefreshConcurrency` | number | 2 | dashboard | Dashboard | How many AI widget refreshes may run as background agents at the same time (1-8). Applies to scheduled refreshes and "Refresh all"; extra refreshes queue. |
| `flashcards.aiModel` | string | "" | flashcards | Flashcards | Model id used for card generation and card discussion. Leave empty to use the chat's active model. |
| `flashcards.aiThinking` | boolean | true | flashcards | Flashcards | Let reasoning models (qwen3.x, DeepSeek-R1) think before writing cards, judging answers or answering discussion questions. Better cards with fewer mistakes, at the cost of slower runs. Turn it off only on a machine where generation is too slow. |
| `flashcards.dailyNewLimit` | number | 20 | flashcards | Flashcards | How many NEW cards one study session introduces. This is a batch size, not a daily ceiling: finishing a session and starting another hands you the next batch, and Custom Study reaches the rest directly. |
| `flashcards.dailyReminder` | boolean | false | flashcards | Flashcards | Schedule a daily background AI check that nudges you (via chat) when cards are due. Runs through the cron scheduler and respects the autonomy dial. |
| `flashcards.dailyReviewLimit` | number | 200 | flashcards | Flashcards | How many due review cards one study session serves. A batch size, not a daily ceiling. |
| `flashcards.freezeDays` | number | 14 | flashcards | Flashcards | Days before the exam when new-card introduction stops and sessions become pure review. The pacing rate is computed to land every card before this window opens. |
| `flashcards.generationContext` | number | 0 | flashcards | Flashcards | Context window (tokens) requested for card generation and discussion. 0 = auto: sized per run from the document length, card count, and the model's real context limit. Set a fixed value only to cap VRAM on smaller machines; material is clipped to fit whatever window is used. |
| `flashcards.generationDensity` | string | "balanced" | flashcards | Flashcards | How selective AI card generation is when the count is Auto. 'thorough' = one card per atomic fact; 'balanced' = every core concept gets a card, minor detail consolidates; 'lean' = exam-critical methods, formulas, and assumptions only. Density shapes selectivity across the whole material - it never truncates coverage mid-chapter. |
| `flashcards.leechThreshold` | number | 5 | flashcards | Flashcards | Lapses before a card is flagged as a leech (repeatedly failed; likely needs rewording). |
| `flashcards.paceNewCards` | boolean | true | flashcards | Flashcards | Pace new-card introduction to each deck's exam date: a session's new batch becomes the rate that finishes introducing every card before the freeze window. It shrinks below the batch size when there is time to spare, and RAISES above it when the deadline needs more - a large deck would otherwise never finish, and the deck card would only show a completion date past the exam. The deck card says when a rate was raised. Decks without an exam date keep the fixed batch. |
| `flashcards.productionDailyLimit` | number | 12 | flashcards | Flashcards | How many cards requiring a typed answer one study session serves. Counted separately from the review batch because a typed answer takes 30-60 seconds against roughly 5 for a recognition card, so mixing them into one allowance would quietly shrink how much you actually cover. 0 = no separate cap. |
| `flashcards.productionRecall` | boolean | true | flashcards | Flashcards | Let AI generation mark cards that should be ANSWERED rather than recognised, and give each one a rubric of the points a correct answer must make. A card is marked for a written answer whenever a correct response is a sentence rather than a bare name or number - definitions included; lists and formulas get their own answer types. Those cards ask you to type an answer, graded against the rubric and the source passage the card came from. Recognising a card you cannot actually state is the main way self-grading overstates what you know. |
| `flashcards.reminderTime` | string | "09:00" | flashcards | Flashcards | Local wall-clock time (HH:MM) for the daily reminder check. |
| `flashcards.shuffle` | boolean | false | flashcards | Flashcards | Shuffle each study session so cards from different decks and chapters mix instead of coming in schedule order. Learning cards still come first. The Shuffle button in the study toolbar toggles this and reorders the rest of the current session. |
| `mediaOrganizer.deleteMode` | permanent \\| trash | "permanent" | media-organizer | Atelier | What Delete does. 'permanent' removes the items and their files at once (through Eraser when it is set up), after asking. 'trash' moves them to Trash without asking; Restore brings them back, and after 30 days they are removed the same way as a permanent delete. |
| `mediaOrganizer.editJpegQuality` | number | 92 | media-organizer | Atelier | Image Editor: JPEG quality for Save As Copy, from 50 to 100. Higher keeps more detail and makes a larger file. PNG photos are saved as PNG and are not affected. |
| `mediaOrganizer.enableArtTools` | boolean | false | media-organizer | Atelier | Drawing and Painting Tools. Shows Daily Study, Practice Sessions and practice history in Atelier, for a workspace that holds reference photos. Off hides them; nothing is deleted. |
| `mediaOrganizer.practiceChime` | boolean | true | media-organizer | Atelier | Play a short chime when a practice picture's time is up. |
| `mediaOrganizer.practiceDailyMinutes` | number | 10 | media-organizer | Atelier | Daily Study: minutes to draw the picture of the day. |
| `mediaOrganizer.practiceGreyscale` | boolean | false | media-organizer | Atelier | Start practice runs with the picture in greyscale. Can be changed during a run. |
| `mediaOrganizer.practiceMirror` | boolean | false | media-organizer | Atelier | Start practice runs with the picture mirrored. Can be changed during a run. |
| `mediaOrganizer.screenRecorderAudio` | off \\| system \\| mic \\| both | "system" | media-organizer | Atelier | Record audio into screen recordings. The sound is saved in the temp video, so MP4/WebM clip exports keep it (GIFs have no audio). 'system' captures whatever is playing on any output device (speakers, Bluetooth, USB, HDMI) via Windows loopback; 'mic' captures the default microphone; 'both' mixes the two into one track (narrate over what plays); 'off' disables audio. |
| `mediaOrganizer.screenRecorderCountdown` | 0 \\| 3 \\| 5 \\| 10 | "0" | media-organizer | Atelier | Off by default: recording starts the moment you press Record. Set 3, 5 or 10 to count down inside the frame first, which gives you time to switch to the window you want to capture. Ctrl+Alt+R starts and stops a recording from any app while the frame is open; Ctrl+Alt+P pauses. |
| `mediaOrganizer.screenRecorderFollowBox` | boolean | false | media-organizer | Atelier | Follow the box: while recording you can drag the frame around and the recording follows it, like a camera. The whole display is captured and the clip editor opens already cropped to the path you made, ready to fine-tune. |
| `mediaOrganizer.screenRecorderShowCursor` | boolean | true | media-organizer | Atelier | Include the mouse pointer in the recording. Turn off for clean product clips; the cursor path is still tracked for Smart Zoom in the clip editor. |
| `mediaOrganizer.screenRecorderTempDir` | string | "" | media-organizer | Atelier | Folder for temporary screen recordings before they are clipped. Must be inside the open workspace. Leave empty to use .parallx/extensions/media-organizer/recordings. |
| `mediaOrganizer.showCardTags` | boolean | true | media-organizer | Atelier | Show each item's tags on the grid card next to the date. Turn off to declutter the grid; tags remain visible in the detail view and sidebar. |
| `study.aiModel` | string | "" | study | Study | Model id used to write and grade questions. Leave empty to use the chat's active model. |
| `study.aiThinking` | boolean | true | study | Study | Let reasoning models think before writing or grading. Better questions and fairer grading, at the cost of slower runs. Turn it off only on a machine where generation is too slow. |
| `study.answerFormat` | string | "mixed" | study | Study | Default answer format for a new session: choose, type, or mixed. Mixed starts on choices and moves a concept to typing once it has been answered right. |
| `study.checkAnchor` | boolean | true | study | Study | Drop a question whose quote is not on its page. |
| `study.checkDistractors` | boolean | true | study | Study | Drop a multiple-choice question when any wrong option could be defended as correct. |
| `study.checkNumeric` | boolean | true | study | Study | Keep a numeric question only when its solution, run in Python, agrees with the stated answer. Needs the workspace Python environment. |
| `study.checkSupport` | boolean | true | study | Study | Drop a question whose quote, read with its page, does not settle its answer. |
| `study.choices` | number | 4 | study | Study | Options per multiple-choice question: 4 or 5. |
| `study.generationContext` | number | 0 | study | Study | Context window (tokens) for generation and grading. 0 = auto: sized per run from the scope's length and the model's limit. A fixed value caps VRAM on a smaller machine. |
| `study.numericTolerance` | number | 0.005 | study | Study | Relative tolerance for a numeric answer to count as right (0.005 = half a percent). |
| `study.questionsPerConcept` | number | 2 | study | Study | How many questions of each format a concept needs before generation considers it covered. |
| `study.sessionSize` | number | 20 | study | Study | Questions per session. Refresh draws the next set from the same scope. |
| `study.staleDays` | number | 14 | study | Study | Days without an answer before a clean concept counts as stale. |
| `study.syllabus` | string | "" | study | Study | What your exam expects: paste the syllabus or learning objectives. Concepts and questions are aimed at it. Empty: questions follow the material alone. |
| `webResearch.braveApiKey` | string | "" | web-research | Web Research | Optional. With a key, web searches go through Brave Search; without one, they go through DuckDuckGo, which limits how often it answers. Get a key at brave.com/search/api. Kept encrypted on this computer. |
| `webResearch.browserFallback` | boolean | true | web-research | Web Research | When a site refuses the plain fetch (a 403 from a bot wall), load the page in a hidden browser window instead. If the site then asks you to prove you are human, the window is shown so you can tick the box; the read goes on once you have. The same rules apply: https only, nothing on this computer or the local network, nothing kept afterwards. |
| `webResearch.dailyBudget` | number | 100 | web-research | Web Research | Most web searches allowed per day. Resets at local midnight. |
| `webResearch.perTurnFetchCap` | number | 20 | web-research | Web Research | Most pages the AI may read in one reply. |
| `webResearch.perTurnSearchCap` | number | 20 | web-research | Web Research | Most web searches the AI may make in one reply. |
| `worksheet.displayDecimals` | 2 \\| 4 \\| 6 \\| 8 \\| full | "4" | worksheet | Worksheets | How many decimals a cell without a number format shows. The stored value and the cell editor keep full precision, and a number format set on a cell always wins. "full" shows everything the engine keeps. |
| `worksheet.examDate` | string | "" | worksheet | Worksheets | The exam date (YYYY-MM-DD). The Dashboard shows the days left to it. Empty when not set. |
| `worksheet.idleMinutes` | number | 10 | worksheet | Worksheets | The study clock counts while a problem or the quiz is on screen. After this many minutes without any input the stretch is taken back, so a break with the tab up counts for nothing. |
| `worksheet.sheetAppearance` | light \\| dark \\| app | "light" | worksheet | Worksheets | Theme for the practice-sheet surface, independent of the app theme. "light" matches the real exam tool (always-white sheet), "dark" pins the sheet dark, "app" follows the workbench light/dark mode. The Sheet Theme button on any open sheet flips between light and dark. |
| `worksheet.xpCashRate` | number | 0 | worksheet | Worksheets | Dollars per 100 XP. Set it and the Dashboard shows what your XP and each reward are worth, and Cash Out records what you paid yourself. 0 turns it off. |
